row.medi_said: maten, uh, matenbisti. ... Don't enjoy it. Matenbisti.
row.why: In the -ish negation drill he left off -ish; Amal: 'No. Where's your ish?'. B11 is only ma + you-form (never la) - the -ish ending is in no bucket, so PROPOSE.
row.proposed_rule: A negative verb takes the -ish ending (ma + verb + ish): ma tinbastish fiyo ziyade, bakulish, bahkish.

rulings.why: Both readers saw it; no bucket covers the -ish ending (B11 = ma + you-form), so PROPOSE per GR-18. t = his first try 25:36 (25:41 is the same line again).
